title: Authentication Identity Context Interaction
description: Draft cross-capability workflow linking authentication login with tenant identity, user membership, host resolution, and RBAC semantics for the first implementation slice. The first workflow assurance slice requires invalid ordering, missing tenant context, missing membership, missing audit, and missing or stale proof evidence to fail closed.
aiGuidance: Preserve this interaction as a semantic contract. Do not collapse tenant identity, membership, and RBAC into authentication implementation details.
ordering: resolve host tenant identity, reject inactive or other-tenant host ownership, validate login request, reject illegal ordering, resolve external identity and membership for the resolved tenant, deny absent or other-tenant membership, project session actor, evaluate permissions for protected surfaces, preserve audit/evidence correlation

steps.description: Resolve request host or custom domain to tenant identity before trusting callback/session context.
Deny unknown, inactive, invalid, reserved, or other-tenant host identity before issuing tenant callback or session context.
Run authentication login workflow and preserve denied/provider-failure outcomes.
Reject membership projection, permission-context readiness, or proof success when host resolution, login decision, membership state, audit evidence, or proof evidence is missing or contradictory.
Resolve external identity and tenant membership for the resolved tenant into a safe session actor; absent or other-tenant membership remains denied.
Apply RBAC permissions to authenticated request context without replacing permissions with role-name resemblance.
